##### Project general facts

The Golf Residence by Fortimo is a prime example of luxury living at its finest, an elegant residential tower where flowing curved balconies and floor-to-ceiling glass give every home a sense of openness and calm. The residences are arranged to make the most of breathtaking panoramas, with the tower overlooking a stunning golf course and a lush green park, so residents wake up to wide, uninterrupted views. Homes are offered in a range of layouts, from bright and comfortable apartments to spacious family residences with a generous master bedroom, additional bedrooms and expansive private terraces designed for outdoor living all year round.

Life here is built around a remarkable collection of amenities, led by the spectacular Oasis Paradise Pool with its shaded cabanas, sunken lounge islands and palm-lined deck. Families are beautifully looked after with the playful Kids Haven, complete with splash fountains, swings and climbing play areas, alongside a basketball court and a serene landscape garden. Residents also enjoy a fully equipped gym with a yoga studio, a stylish coworking space, a social zone with games and communal tables, a multi-purpose room and an impressive double-height lobby with an elegant drop-off arrival.

Inside, the interiors are warm, refined and finished to an exceptionally high standard, with open-plan living and dining spaces that flow seamlessly onto the balconies. The kitchens are a real highlight, combining rich timber cabinetry, dramatic marble surfaces and backsplashes, sleek integrated storage and a sculptural island that doubles as a breakfast bar. Bedrooms feature soft textured wall finishes, bespoke headboards and concealed cove lighting, while the bathrooms pair marble walls with custom joinery, walk-in wardrobes and beautifully detailed vanities, creating a home that feels genuinely luxurious in every corner.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Hills Estate is a prestigious and vibrant master-planned community located in the heart of Dubai. It represents a harmonious blend of luxury living, natural beauty, and modern urban design. At the heart of Dubai Hills Estate is the stunning 18-hole championship golf course, designed to international standards. The golf course adds a touch of greenery and serenity to the landscape, attracting golf enthusiasts from around the world.

The project is not just a residential development; it's a comprehensive lifestyle destination. The Dubai Hills Mall, a world-class shopping and entertainment center, offers an array of retail, dining, and entertainment options. Residents and visitors can also enjoy the Central Park, a vast expanse of greenery and relaxation. One of the remarkable features is its emphasis on sustainability and eco-friendly design. The community incorporates modern infrastructure, smart technologies, and sustainable practices to create an environmentally responsible living environment.

The development is strategically located with easy access to key areas of Dubai, including Downtown Dubai, Dubai Marina, and Dubai International Airport. It offers a range of educational institutions, healthcare facilities, and recreational amenities, ensuring that residents have everything they need right at their doorstep. Dubai Hills Estate is a testament to Dubai's commitment to providing residents with an exceptional living experience. Whether you're seeking luxury, natural beauty, or modern conveniences, the project has it all, making it a sought-after destination for those looking for the perfect blend of urban and natural living.
